title: Statue of Unity Express — The Essential Day

stops.note: First slot of the day; viewing gallery before the museum
Ask whether gates are releasing — it changes the priority
Claim sightlines 45 min early on weekends

day_notes.note: Book the earliest viewing-gallery slot online days ahead. E-buses link every stop; food court for lunch. Never plan this for a Monday — the campus closes.

notes: Doable as a long day-trip from Vadodara (~90 km each way); staying the night upgrades it enormously.
